Name: top 10 albums based on tracks
Query:
SELECT al.AlbumId, al.Title AS AlbumTitle, ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Album al
JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title, ar.Name
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 10;

Name: top 10 Playlist with most number of tracks
Query: select b.Name, count(*) as TrackCount from PlaylistTrack a join Playlist b on a.PlaylistId =b.PlaylistId group by b.PlaylistId, b.Name order by TrackCount DESC LIMIT 10
